t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-bool"></level-ref>带来了真和假。先定义比大小，再用它定义取大的。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-bool"></level-ref> brought true and false. Define comparison first, then the larger of two with it.

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: 两边各去掉一个 S，大小关系不变。
hint.en: Taking one S off each side leaves the comparison as it was.

t.zh: x ≤ y 的值是真或假。两个数都要拆开，所以有三行：0 和任何数比，S x 和 0 比，S x 和 S y 比。
t.en: x ≤ y is true or false. Both numbers are taken apart, so there are three rows: 0 against any number, S x against 0, S x against S y.

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: 看哪一行的条件说 x 不比 y 大。
hint.en: Look for the row whose condition says x is no bigger than y.

t.zh: max 不拆数，而看 x ≤ y 的真假：真假各一行，每行带一个条件。
t.en: max takes no number apart; it looks at whether x ≤ y is true: one row for true, one for false, each with a condition.
